plan.statistical_unit: training seed after averaging paired workloads; evaluation episodes are not independent training replicates
plan.primary_outcome: request-weighted DSR over all generated service requests
plan.design_note: The only intended difference is that the upper actor additionally observes currently unadmitted UEs within the pre-existing 460 m sensing radius. The actor tensor size, lower MLP architecture, reward, physical 100 m admission rule, training budget, and paired exogenous scenarios remain the same. This assumes pre-admission UE beacon/request information is available to the UAV controller; it is exploratory, not part of the frozen canonical method.
plan.decision_rule: Compare paired seed/workload DSR with 95% crossed-bootstrap interval. Inspect admission, conditional deadline success, energy, and fairness before deciding whether to run a separate untouched confirmation cohort.
